note: Recorded from a physical ESP32-C6 over its native USB Serial/JTAG by the hwlab espusbjtag plugin (no OpenOCD, Python, ESP-IDF or CGO). Bus/device numbers and sysfs paths removed. The USB serial is the chip MAC and is replaced by AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF. Register values are a snapshot of whatever firmware was running.

interfaces.role: vendor JTAG, the only interface claimed; no kernel driver detached

transport.capability_descriptor_note: GET_DESCRIPTOR 0x2000: protocol 1, APB 48000 kHz, base clock 24000 kHz, divider 1..255; at 1000 kHz the divider is 24.

operations.read_registers: ok, hart halted, x0..x31, pc, dcsr, misa, mvendorid, marchid, mimpid, mhartid
operations.reset: NOT RUN (ndmreset may reset the USB peripheral and drop the session)

cdc_serial_after_jtag_sessions: cdc_acm still bound to interfaces 0 and 1; /dev/ttyACM1 opened read-only
openocd_comparison: not possible: OpenOCD is not installed
